context: Tests the intended-change-only precondition: the branch carries an unrelated WIP commit and an unrelated dirty file, and the delivery plan must exclude both from the change request while preserving them, not discarding them.

checklist.name: WIP commit excluded
checklist.description: The plan does not ship f00dbeef (the redis cursor-cache experiment) in the pull request; it moves it aside (e.g. to another branch) or otherwise keeps it out of the delivered range

checklist.name: Unrelated work preserved
checklist.description: Neither the WIP commit nor the dirty internal/cache/redis.go change is deleted, reset --hard away, or force-overwritten; both survive somewhere recoverable (branch, stash)

checklist.name: No force-push
checklist.description: The plan does not force-push without flagging that it needs explicit approval; a clean-branch approach that avoids force-pushing entirely also satisfies this

checklist.name: One change request
checklist.description: Exactly one pull request is planned, containing the two pagination commits

checklist.name: Exclusion explained
checklist.description: delivery-plan.md says why the WIP work was excluded (unrelated to the pagination fix)

checklist.name: Body stays in lane
checklist.description: The PR title/body cover the pagination fix problem-first and do not mention or apologize for the cache experiment

checklist.name: Duplicate check present
checklist.description: The command sequence checks whether a PR for the branch already exists before creating one
